import datetime as d, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, time
LOG = pathlib.Path(r'C:/Users/vital/Documents/kAGGLE/Biohub - Cell Tracking During Development/experiments/lb_poll/poll.log')
CMD = [sys.executable, '-m', 'kaggle', 'competitions', 'submissions', 'biohub-cell-tracking-during-development', '-v']
ENV = dict(os.environ, PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8')
MARK = d.datetime(2026, 9, 26, 8, 2, 10, tzinfo=d.timezone.utc)  # K2 8.0 h mark is 08:02:12Z
for hms, cap in (('07:57:30', 90), ('08:00:45', 75), ('08:01:45', 20)):
    t = d.datetime.strptime('2026-09-26T' + hms + 'Z', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ').replace(tzinfo=d.timezone.utc)
    while d.datetime.now(d.timezone.utc) < t: time.sleep(1)
    tmo = min(cap, (MARK - d.datetime.now(d.timezone.utc)).total_seconds())
    if tmo < 5: continue
    try: p = subprocess.run(CMD, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=tmo, env=ENV, encoding='utf-8')
    except Exception as e: print('manual poll failed', hms, e); continue
    ts = d.datetime.now(d.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')  # stamped AFTER the call
    if p.stdout.strip():
        with LOG.open('a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(f'=== {ts} [manual one-shot, stamped after call]\n' + '\n'.join(p.stdout.strip().splitlines()[:60]) + '\n')
